configs.description: The finger duct as Tripp Lite ships SRCABLEDUCTVRT, the cover fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same duct with the cover taken off, the two slotted walls and the channel between them open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the duct, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: neither the specification sheet nor the submittal drawing states how many cables the duct holds, a fill or a bend radius.
gaps.wanted: a cable capacity and its basis from the owner's manual or a later datasheet

gaps.note: the specification sheet gives product height 2.04 in and width 4.06 in; the drawing's table gives 1.9 x 2.83 x 34.13 in in inches and 51.82 x 103.12 x 867 mm in millimetres, which are not the same figures; its dimensioned views give 48.47 x 71.95 over the button x 862.6 mm. The views are drawn. The length is 862.6 on the three views and 867 on the table and the sheet, 4.4 mm longer.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual, or a dimensioned drawing of the assembled two-piece duct

gaps.note: Eaton names it a 6 ft (1.83 m) manager and the drawing says it is a two piece design, split into two 3-foot sections, but every view dimensions 862.6 mm (33.96 in) and the sheet gives 34.13 in, which is about one 3-foot section, not 6 ft. Nothing says whether the drawing shows one section or the assembled run, and no view shows a joint or how far apart two back plates stand. It is drawn as one length of 862.6 mm with no seam, and is not called 6 ft here.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of one section and of the assembled duct, or the owner's manual

gaps.note: the specification sheet and the drawing give 1.8 kg (4 lb); neither says whether that is one section or both.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual, or the shipping weight with the number of sections in the carton

gaps.note: the side view dimensions a slot 44.99 mm [1.77 in] long, and the slot as drawn measures about 42.8 mm at the scale the 62.71 mm overall gives (115 px of 170 at 300 dpi). The dimension is drawn. The first slot is placed 3.1 mm from the top and the last leaves 5.5 mm at the foot (estimated); the drawing measures about 2.7 mm and 2 mm, against a scale that is not self-consistent. The lip depth, 7.72 mm (62.71 less 54.99), is worked out from the dimensions; the picture shows about 10.6 mm.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned detail of one slot

gaps.note: the rear view draws the plate narrower at its top end, and the end view draws the button's stepped profile and the hooks at the cover's edge; none is drawn (the button is a plain block on the end and side faces). The five holes are drawn at an estimated size and no document says what they are for, so no pass-through is declared. The rear draws the holes as dark decor, while the cover-off front shows the base's holes cut through; the two faces disagree and the drawing does not settle it.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned detail of the plate's end and of the button

gaps.note: the drawing says "toolless mounting buttons" and draws three concentric circles as the PDU button's drawing does; no document gives the shaft or the slot it hangs in, so the mating `pdu-button` is by mechanism and not checked by dimension.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual page that shows the hanging

gaps.note: no document says how the cover is held on or removed, so it is drawn as one plate that lifts off; the format has no clip.
gaps.wanted: the owner's manual page that shows the cover fitted
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - cold rolled steel (the drawing's specification table), black, RoHS and EIA-310-E (the sheet's compliances).

capacity.note: datasheet - no cable capacity, fill or bend radius is stated in either document. None is recorded and none is estimated; a gap says so.

chassis.note: drawing - 48.47 x 862.6 x 71.95 (1.91 x 33.96 x 2.83 in): the rear and end views dimension the width, the rear and side views the length and the end view the depth over the button. The channel is 40 wide and 62.71 deep over the plate (end view), the button standing 9.24 behind it.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black" is the sheet's. The drawing is line work and the photograph on it is the maker's, so the whole is this library's render of black steel, its greys lifted from near-black so the part reads on both stages.

cover.note: datasheet - the cover ships fitted (the specification sheet's title and package contents, "finger duct with cover"). It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`, as a lid; no clip is drawn.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted: the front view draws the plate 48.47 wide with the cover's outline inside it, about 4.5 short of each end (estimated, read at 0.985 px/mm). The two walls and the channel between them are the end and side views'. The `duct` guide is the 37.8 mm clear between the walls over the full length.

guides.note: estimated - THE FINGERS ARE ON BOTH WALLS, AND THE COUNT IS READ, NOT STATED. The side view dimensions the pitch 18 mm and a slot 44.99 mm long; 48 slots are counted on it. The drawing's title row calls them "double finger ducts" (item A). The slots are punched, closed at both ends, so no tip is free. A cable is laid along the channel and passes between the walls through a slot.

left.note: drawing - the side view: the plate and the two buttons behind it, the wall with its 48 slots, and the cover's lip over the end of the slots. The right is the same wall seen from the other side, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE SUBMITTAL DRAWING, page 2: a rear, side, front and end view with millimetres in brackets. The rear view is 0.985 px/mm at 110 dpi along the 862.6 and the side view the same, so both are orthographic. The slot pitch is counted, not dimensioned beyond the 18 mm: 48 slots, read as 96 slot edges down the side view at 250 dpi.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`: the part hangs on two toolless mounting buttons on its back, 622 mm [24.49 in] apart on the rear view, the first 123.5 mm [4.86 in] from the top end and the second 117.10 mm [4.61 in] from the foot. Page 1 shows it hanging inside an enclosure's frame beside the equipment and says it is compatible with most standard 19 in enclosures and open frame racks. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 20` is the 862.6 it runs, 862.6 / 44.45 = 19.4 rounded up, as the library's other zero-U parts state it (estimated: no source sells it by rack units).

rear.note: drawing - the rear view: the plate with two buttons on its centre line, 123.5 from the top and 117.10 from the foot, and five holes down the same line 200 mm apart. Each button is three concentric circles 25.7, 17.5 and 10 mm across (read at 5.4 px/mm), which are the PDU button's 26.0, 18.6 and 9.3, so eaton/tripplite-mounting-button@1 is used. The holes' diameter and the first hole's place are estimated. The plate's two edges are turned up toward the front, 10.4 mm (28 px on the end view at 2.686 px/mm, estimated), and are drawn as an edge strip on each side; the plate is narrower at its top end, which is not drawn.

size-conflict.note: THE DRAWING'S VIEWS WIN OVER ITS OWN TABLE AND THE SHEET. The specification sheet gives product height 2.04 in, width 4.06 in and depth 34.13 in; page 1 of the drawing gives unit dimensions "1.9 x 2.83 x 34.13 in (51.82 x 103.12 x 867 mm)", whose inch and millimetre figures disagree (2.83 in is 71.9 mm, and 103.12 mm is 4.06 in). The dimensioned views of page 2 agree with the inch figures and not with the millimetre ones: the plate 48.47 mm [1.91 in] wide, 71.95 mm [2.83 in] over the button, 862.6 mm [33.96 in] long. The sheet's 2.04 x 4.06 in is the drawing's millimetre row and matches no view; it is not used. The length is 862.6 on all three views and 867 mm (34.13 in) on the table and the sheet: the views are taken and the 4.4 mm is a gap.

sources.note: THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, both read from the Eaton SKU page of SRCABLEDUCTVRT. The specification sheet (skuPage.SRCABLEDUCTVRT.pdf, two pages, the second only the project-name form, (c) 2026 Eaton) and the submittal drawing (13-03-167, two pages, (c) 2013 Tripp Lite). No document names terms of use for the drawing; figures were read and nothing was copied. The SmartRack Accessories Visio stencil linked on the page was not read.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states the gauge. 1.1 mm is taken, as for the 1U ducts, from the end view, which draws a wall of about that gauge.

top.note: drawing - the end view, rear at y=0: the button, the plate, the two walls and the cover's plate and lips. The duct is open at its end and a cable runs out of it there. The bottom is the same.

weight.note: datasheet - 1.8 kg (4 lb), the specification sheet's product weight and the drawing's unit weight.
